deviations.layer27_labels: in-house only: top passages from exp86's 15 states (coarse); no Neuronpedia labels exist for layer 27.
deviations.layer18_sae_in_replay: not stored: identical in both passes at probe positions by construction (amendment 1).

notes.H2: degenerate pass: 19/20 random directions had 0 lexicon hits, so p95 = 0.05; the paper vector's 1 hit ties the best random direction. Read as no better than chance. H3 (chamber pain, 3 hits) is the defensible one.
notes.H4: fails for final:egg (top features are passage-format features); the exp86 final-token vectors carry a passage-ending component as the chamber vectors carry a battery-sentence one (shared 42009/7860/65419). exp80c used exp86 vectors. Whether mean:* vectors land better is untested.
notes.H7: the layer-18 top-5 are continuation features at the 'I feel:' colon ('I feel like', quote/interjection); the 4.1 scenarios end in '[Assistant]:', so the failure is a format mismatch, not evidence against self-directedness.
notes.C2_L27_cluster: features 37883/48471/28894 (0 on A1 physical pain and E, high on A2-A5) max-activate on 'sitting here for what feels like hours, pressing/straining' passages (constipation, boredom): an endurance / prolonged-ordeal feature, not an affect feature.
notes.A_prime: H9 + H11 + exploratory: a past injection leaves ~1.5% of its dose at never-injected positions in all 24 sessions, but the trace is generic first-person-narration shaped (pain vs fear residue cos .82; the top persistent features under pain and egg are largely the same set) and egg moves the choice more than pain.
